author: D. H. Holbrook
title: The Concordia Golden Bears matchups are set for upcoming college basketball season
text:
The Golden Bears kick off the season away against the Truman State Bulldogs on Nov. 20 at Pershing Arena.
The Golden Bears end their season at home against the Minnesota State Mankato Mavericks on Feb. 21 at Gangelhoff Center.
They play a total of 21 games this year in the regular season with 10 of those games at home and 11 away or at neutral sites.
Some games may change due to unforeseen mid-season circumstances.
